CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.supportflow_agent_due_tenants(p_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(tenant_code character varying)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 WITH due AS (
   SELECT r.tenant_code,r.created_at FROM public.agent_run r
   WHERE ((r.state IN ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT') AND r.ready_at<=clock_timestamp())
      OR (r.state='RUNNING' AND (r.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() OR r.deadline_at<=clock_timestamp())))
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_run earlier WHERE earlier.tenant_code=r.tenant_code AND earlier.session_no=r.session_no
      AND earlier.run_id<>r.run_id AND (earlier.state='RUNNING' OR
         (earlier.event_seq<r.event_seq AND (earlier.state NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') OR earlier.error_code='SIDE_EFFECT_UNKNOWN'))))
   UNION ALL
   SELECT r.tenant_code,r.created_at FROM public.agent_approval a
   JOIN public.agent_run r ON r.tenant_code=a.tenant_code AND r.run_id=a.run_id
   WHERE a.status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED') AND a.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
     AND r.state IN ('WAITING_APPROVAL','PENDING','RETRY_WAIT','RUNNING')
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_step s WHERE s.tenant_code=r.tenant_code AND s.run_id=r.run_id
       AND s.effect='WRITE' AND s.state IN ('RESERVED','UNKNOWN'))
 )
 SELECT due.tenant_code FROM due GROUP BY due.tenant_code
 ORDER BY min(due.created_at),due.tenant_code
 LIMIT greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,32),100))
$function$

functions.supportflow_channel_tenant(p_app_key tex:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.supportflow_channel_tenant(p_app_key text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
    SELECT (SELECT min(k.tenant_code)::text
    FROM public.channel_key AS k
    JOIN public.channel AS c ON c.id = k.channel_id AND c.tenant_code = k.tenant_code
    WHERE length(p_app_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 64
      AND k.app_key = p_app_key AND k.status = 1 AND NOT k.is_deleted
      AND (k.expire_time IS NULL OR k.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
      AND c.status = 1 AND NOT c.is_deleted
      AND k.tenant_code ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,15}$'
      AND upper(k.tenant_code) <> 'PLATFORM'
    HAVING count(*) = 1)
$function$
functions.supportflow_public_bot_avatar(p_id bigin:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.supportflow_public_bot_avatar(p_id bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(file_name character varying, mime_type character varying, object_key character varying)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
    SELECT f.file_name, f.mime_type, f.object_key
    FROM public.file_meta f
    WHERE f.id = p_id AND f.biz_type = 1 AND NOT f.is_deleted
      AND starts_with(f.object_key, 'bot/avatar/' || f.tenant_code || '/')
$function$
functions.supportflow_wechat_tenant(p_app_id text):
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.supportflow_wechat_tenant(p_app_id text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
    SELECT (SELECT min(w.tenant_code)::text
    FROM public.channel_wechat_config AS w
    JOIN public.channel AS c ON c.id = w.channel_id AND c.tenant_code = w.tenant_code
    WHERE length(p_app_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND w.app_id = p_app_id
      AND w.status = 1 AND NOT w.is_deleted AND c.status = 1 AND NOT c.is_deleted
      AND c.channel_type IN (2, 3)
      AND w.tenant_code ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,15}$'
      AND upper(w.tenant_code) <> 'PLATFORM'
    HAVING count(*) = 1)
$function$

views.tenant_rls_status:
SELECT c.relname AS table_name,
    c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled,
    c.relforcerowsecurity AS rls_forced,
    ( SELECT count(1) AS count
           FROM pg_policies p
          WHERE p.schemaname = 'public'::name AND p.tablename = c.relname) AS policy_count
   FROM pg_class c
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'::name AND c.relkind = 'r'::"char" AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM information_schema.columns col
          WHERE col.table_schema::name = 'public'::name AND col.table_name::name = c.relname AND col.column_name::name = 'tenant_code'::name));
